text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOOOO!!!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Haaah!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —I love you all...!
(SKREEEEEECH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I shall shatter it!!! Your 
chained-up potential, that is!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: AND NOWWW!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: "By my brilliance!! Be reborn!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
T-TANINO GIMLET! AN INCREDIBLE LATE 
SURGE!! TANINO GIMLET BLASTS INTO THE LEAD 
IN ONE FELL SWOOP--!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: I DESTROY!!!! THEREFORE――――I AM!!!!!!!!
(WOOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
âBehold the eternal brilliance that lies 
beyond ruin.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
—Hahahaha! I lose, I lose!! A total 
defeat, Gimlet!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Your romantic vision— is on a scale that's 
just a bit too massive. Thanks to that, we 
got completely burned and capsized!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
However... it feels delightful. Almost 
like discovering an uncharted continent.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh. Is that a golden ocean dwelling 
in your eyes――

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"...I'll definitely pay you back someday. 
You're the one who smashed it, so it's 
only fair I smash yours too, right?"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Challenge the "God of Destruction" 
as many times as you like. I shall crush 
you as many times as it takes――

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Just you wait! We'll meet again, 'God of 
Destruction'—"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Can only be "observed"—"reached" in this 
universe... "Connection" and 
"Destruction."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "DSTY" is... very Sphira, isn't it.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hah, don't you dare be satisfied with 
this. Neo Universe.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I need you to witness it with your own 
eyes. The ultimate end brought about by my 
destruction.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Alright. Tanino Gimlet's "UNIV"— I know 
now that it means to "connect"—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Neo Universe too... chooses "revolution".

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Then let us march forth! Together with 
us, toward the new horizon—and beyond!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Only then will it be—my destiny.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...It's Tanino Gimlet.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
(GIMLEEEEET!!! LADY GIMLEEEET!!! GOD OF 
DESTRUCTIOOOON!!!)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
O, my beloved observers! Tremble in awe! 
This is but the prologue to a legend...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Glorious chaos remains far off— The 
principles to be shattered, still so many—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Thus, thirst for it! Feast your eyes! 
Upon the manifold ruin wrought by this 
"God of Destruction"!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I shall guide you all!!! Into a new world 
swirling with an unknown future!!!!!

The finale brought forth by the "God of 
Destruction" kept Tokyo Racecourse rocking 
with prolonged, fiery heat――
And—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...How are you feeling today?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: I see. —That is splendid news.

After the Japan Cup, I went to our usual 
spot with Tanino Gimlet to raise a 
celebratory toast...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...You look like you have something you 
want to say.
choice_data_list:
I was just wondering where we should head 
next.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh— We can head anywhere.

Saying so, Tanino Gimlet placed a shaker 
in front of me. It's... empty.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Our future is just like that shaker.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...Do you understand what that means?

Staring intently at the shaker, I think. 
Remembering Tanino Gimlet's words up until 
now, the answer I arrived at was—
choice_data_list:
So that means we can make anything from 
now on, huh?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Splendid. For you who have come this far, 
that was a foolish question.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, like gods, we are entirely free 
in what we pour into it and what we 
create.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Predetermined by no one... A future 
harboring infinite possibilities. In other 
words————chaos.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: We are now――――brethren of chaos.
choice_data_list:
...Sounds good. A fellow creature of 
chaos, huh?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Let us continue walking together, to twist 
and reshape a supreme, unfixed future.

Saying so, I held up the empty glass. 
Naturally, just like Tanino Gimlet, 
carrying nothing but genuine feelings—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —Cheers.

The pleasant clinking of glasses together 
rang out with comforting warmth, just like 
every other day—
